spec_match.rationale: Feature-detects the real directive vocabulary via document.featurePolicy and honestly scopes Direct Sockets to Isolated Web Apps.

interactive.rationale: The single 'Detect policies' button runs a real detection pass and the page surfaces the pre-151 vs post-merger header patterns.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised in-session directive detection and applicable header pattern.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the not-an-IWA case in prose, but a single detect action leaves inheritance and denial branches to the sibling explorer page.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 4 pass / 2 fail in this Chromium 141 session.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: clicked Detect policies; header-pattern readouts rendered; zero console errors and no failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Only injected page-level telemetry.js; no per-demo assert telemetry.

design_system.rationale: Shared CSS variables, no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Native button is keyboard-operable, but detection results are text swaps without an aria-live region.

openQuestions.title: Announce detection results via a live region
openQuestions.detail: The Detect policies readout updates as plain text; wrapping the result area in aria-live=polite (or role=status) would surface the outcome to screen readers without re-reading the page.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: clicked 'Detect policies', saw the pre-151 vs merged header patterns render with honest IWA-only framing, zero console errors; conformance panel honestly 4 pass / 2 fail.
